question: Do Hyperliquid vaults whose leaders did well over one period keep doing better than other vaults over the next period, after accounting for deposits/withdrawals and survivorship?
registration_note: Registered 2026-10-12, before the daily panel (hyperliquid-vaults-collection-v1) holds more than one snapshot and before any vault return was computed. Independent evidence outside the repo's own strategies: public, on-chain-verifiable track records of thousands of automated and discretionary traders. Descriptive research; no copy-trading, no deposits, no live trading.
data: daily snapshots from hyperliquid-vaults-panel-v1 (all vaults, open and closed, as listed at each snapshot)
returns: daily flow-adjusted vault return r_t = (pnl_alltime_t - pnl_alltime_(t-1)) / tvl_(t-1), using the snapshot pnl_alltime_last and tvl; a vault-day is valid only if both snapshots exist and tvl_(t-1) >= 10,000 USD; |r_t| > 50% is treated as a data error and excluded (counted and reported)
universe: vaults with relationship_type 'normal' (protocol vaults such as HLP reported separately), at least 20 valid days in the formation window

design.rebalance: non-overlapping 30-day periods starting at the first date with >= 30 days of panel
design.sorts: each formation period, rank eligible vaults by formation-window cumulative flow-adjusted return; terciles
design.statistic: mean holding-period return of the top tercile minus the bottom tercile (equal-weighted across vaults), and the Spearman rank correlation between formation and holding returns
design.survivorship: a vault that closes or disappears during the holding period is kept with its returns up to its last valid day and 0 afterwards; closures are counted per tercile

tests.H1: mean top-minus-bottom tercile spread across periods > 0, t-statistic >= 2.0 (periods as observations)
tests.null: action-matched: 999 random tercile assignments per period among the same eligible vaults (review_methods), p <= 0.05

review: single look once the panel holds at least 7 complete formation+holding cycles (about 7 months; earliest around 2027-05); review_methods.assert_single_look guards the date. Before that: collection counts only.
